notes.title: Update v3.9.0
notes.content: [p][b]Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Multiplayer Lobby UI[/p][list][*][p]Pick your Racer model and color before the race 🎨[/p][/*][*][p]Invite Steam Friends directly to a remote play session from inside the game 💌[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ghosts now reflect your customization[/p][list][*][p]Builder & Racer ghosts use your chosen color[/p][/*][*][p]Racer ghosts now match the model you used.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Leaderboard upgrades 🏆[/p][list][*][p]Watch replays of any player[/p][/*][*][p]Add other players as ghosts to race against 👻[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Checkpoint info UI[/p][list][*][p]Now Shows Checkpoint Time and Time Delta better[/p][/*][*][p]Shows Sector Delta (Slower Faster)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Removed max speed limit 🚀[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Fixes & Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tweaked Racer steering sensitivity after hitting track borders[/p][/*][*][p]Changed boost pad behavior[/p][/*][*][p]Leaderboard scrolling works properly[/p][/*][*][p]UI behaves correctly when watching leaderboard replays[/p][/*][*][p]Faster level loading → Long tracks now load almost instantly[/p][list][*][p]Example: a 5-minute track went from 12s load time to under 0.5s[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved timer accuracy for both Racer & Builder[/p][list][*][p]Previously limited to physics updates (~1/50th sec)[/p][/*][*][p]Now accurate to the thousandth of a second[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791032/01742dfbbc158ef78a489f7f0180b73ecf2a7621.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update v3.3.3
notes.content:
New Local Multiplayer mode. Two players build a track at the same time ⚔️ then they both race on the faster track 🏎️.

🏆 Competition in the single-player going on until the 20th of May.

Sign-up for the playtest: [url=https://supersonicbridgeracing.ch/playtest-signup]https://supersonicbridgeracing.ch/playtest-signup[/url] and play the level FABA2024. (fastest times wins 55 CHF, one lucky participant wins 25 CHF) 🏆

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*] New Local Multiplayer Mode! [list]
[*] 2 Players create a track at the same time, the faster one gets a point
[*] Both race on the faster track, the faster Racer gets a point
[*] First to get 4 points wins [/list]
[*] New Competition Level [list]
[*] Play FABA2024 and win 55 CHF.
[/list][/list]
[b]Small features / tweaks[/b]
[list]
[*] Speedlines when reaching higher speeds
[*] Level Detail view in Single-player (allows you to see the leaderboard before playing)
[*] B to go back in menus
[*] New Collision sounds
[*] New Background Music Selection
[*] Long press for some actions to avoid loosing your track-data
[*] Builder handling
[*] Racer handling
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed visual holes in Track
[*] More accurate collision detection for track Building
[*] (building) Invisible collision box at start of track was fixed
[*] Racer should not get stuck on the track anymore
[*] Music should be muted when alt-tab
[*] UI working on ultrawide screens
[/list]
Please join the discord and tell me what you think!
[url=https://discord.gg/Mp7Tqfsemr]Supersonic Bridge Racing Discord[/url]

notes.title: Update 3.2.5
notes.content:
During the last month I focused a lot on the new acceleration and breaking feature for the builder. The Builder visual has also evolved, now feeling much faster and in line with the Racer.

Features:
[list]
[*] New Builder Model (big thanks to @gher)
[*] Acceleration and Breaking for Builder
[*] Racer and Builder time are added together for a new level time
[*] Return of the Stars
[list]
[*] New target times for all levels have been created
[*] Gain up to 5 stars with a fast run
[/list]
[*] Local Multiplayer 1v1 chase race prototype
[list]
[*] Currently not well balanced
[*] Gain up to 5 stars with a fast run
[/list]
[/list]
Bug fixes and other improvements:
[list]
[*] Removed health bar of the Racer in Single-player
[*] Better Racer and Builder Ghosts
[*] Holding acceleration on Restart should now work
[*] Pause Menu now shows the controls and allows to restart a level
[/list]
I am looking forward to hear form you guys how you like the new feeling of the Builder! This is something I want to improve further and will be a focus for the next month. Additionally, I am thinking about new game-modes for the local multiplayer as I am not happy with the balance of the current chase race.

Please join the discord and tell me what you think!
[url=https://discord.gg/Mp7Tqfsemr]Supersonic Bridge Racing Discord[/url]
